MENU_NEW_GAME_DESC: Start a new music career from scratch with Alex in the small bedroom.
MENU_TEST_MODE_DESC: Launch a test game with pre-configured character, 10 songs, and resources ready to test every system.
MENU_QUICK_START_DESC: Launch directly into the life cycle simulation and testing screen.
MENU_SETTINGS_DESC: Open the general settings and language panel.
SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_DESC: Select the language for on-screen text and screen reader speech output.
SETTINGS_BACK_DESC: Save preferences and return to the main menu.
HUD_BTN_PRACTICE_ACC_DESC: Shortcut 1. Takes 10 seconds, costs 15 energy and grants instrument XP.
HUD_BTN_PAUSE_ACC_DESC: Shortcut Space. Freezes or resumes time.
HUD_BTN_SAVE_ACC_DESC: Saves the current game state to disk.
HUD_BTN_MAIN_MENU_ACC_DESC: Saves current state and exits to the main menu screen.
HUD_BTN_CATALOG_ACC_DESC: Shortcut M. View all your songs, drafts and singles.
HUD_BTN_NEW_SONG_ACC_DESC: Shortcut N. Open the creation studio to craft a new song.
HUD_BTN_CONCERT_ACC_DESC: Shortcut L. Pick a venue, prepare setlist, and perform live for your crowd.
MSG_SAVE_BLOCKED_BUSY: Cannot save while an action is in progress.
THEME_DESC_LOVE: A song focusing on love, passion, or romantic relationships.
THEME_DESC_REBELLION: An anthem of disruption, rebellion against conventions, or youth resistance.
THEME_DESC_MELANCHOLY: Introspective lyrics, reflections on loneliness or bittersweet memories.
THEME_DESC_SUCCESS: Ambition, self-assertion, social redemption, and achieved goals.
THEME_DESC_NIGHT: Nocturnal atmospheres, club culture, escapism, or secrets in the dark.
THEME_DESC_SOCIAL_ANGER: Denouncing injustices, urban tension, and collective indignation.
THEME_DESC_CURSED_LOVE: Tormented relationships, destructive passions, and dark bonds.
THEME_DESC_YOUTH_NOSTALGIA: Remembrances of teenage years, past summers, and early dreams.
THEME_DESC_ESCAPISM: Desire to travel elsewhere, dreamlike worlds, and sensory ecstasy.
THEME_DESC_POLITICAL_SATIRE: Sharp irony about power, media, and social contradictions.
CATALOG_EMPTY: No tracks in catalog. Press 'N' to create a new song!
CATALOG_BTN_EDIT_ACC_DESC: Resumes crafting from current stage or edits song metadata.
MSG_SONG_RELEASED: Single '%s' has been released! Final quality: %.1f / 100.
VENUE_GARAGE_DESC: Friends and acquaintances: easy applause, zero revenue.
VENUE_PUB_DESC: Distracted patrons: charisma needed to quiet the bar.
VENUE_SMALL_CLUB_DESC: Music enthusiasts: attentive listening, high fan conversion.
VENUE_TRENDY_CLUB_DESC: Critics and industry insiders: springboard to the national scene.
EVENT_STRING_DESC: Right in the middle of the song, a string snaps with a loud crack!
EVENT_AUDIO_DESC: A violent acoustic feedback shrieks through the PA system!
EVENT_AUDIO_CHOICE_1: 1. Make a witty joke on mic (Charisma)
EVENT_FAN_DESC: An excited spectator leaps onto the stage grabbing the microphone stand!
EVENT_FAN_CHOICE_1: 1. Hug them and share the chorus (Charisma)
EVENT_OUTCOME_SUCCESS: Brilliant success! The crowd erupts in enthusiastic cheering!
EVENT_OUTCOME_FAILURE: Awkward moment barely recovered amidst disappointed murmurs.
CONCERT_LABEL_SOUNDCHECK: Perform Soundcheck (-15 Energy, +5% acoustic, zero audio issues)
CONCERT_NO_PLAYABLE_SONGS: No ready or released tracks. Produce a song in the Music Studio (N) before organizing a gig!
HUD_BTN_SPEED_ACC_DESC: Shortcut T. Cycle game simulation speed between 1x, 2x, and 3x.
HUD_BTN_ECONOMY_ACC_DESC: Shortcut B. View balance, living expenses, job shift, and runway days.
HUD_BTN_CHARACTER_ACC_DESC: Shortcut C. View musician biography, vital needs, and the 7 skills matrix.
JOB_RETAIL_DESC: Record shop shift: pays €55.00, -20 Energy, +5 Stress.
JOB_WAITER_DESC: Pub night shift: pays €45.00, -25 Energy, +10 Stress.
JOB_ERR_UNEMPLOYED: You have no day job, you are a full-time musician!
JOB_ERR_ENERGY: Insufficient energy to work your regular job shift.
BANK_RUNWAY: Estimated Financial Runway: %.1f days (Fixed expenses: €%.2f / day)
BANK_BTN_RESIGN: Take the Leap (Resign from Day Job)
HUD_BTN_BAND_ACC_DESC: Shortcut G. View band members, affinity, respect, tension, and recruitment board.
CATALOG_EMPTY: No music in catalog. Press 'N' to compose or 'P' to produce an album!
CATALOG_BTN_EDIT_ACC_DESC: Opens music creator to finish drafting stages.
HUD_BTN_INDUSTRY_ACC_DESC: Shortcut K. Inspect Indie and Major record deals, recoupment debt and hire a manager.
